test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is INCORRECT regarding the factors that inflamed the feelings of the Sepoys and led to the Revolt of 1857?

options.text: Act that required every new recruit to give an undertaking to serve overseas
Army maintaining chaplains at state cost and promotion of Christian propaganda among the sepoys
Compulsion on sepoys to wear their caste marks and follow their own caste

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Compulsion on sepoys to wear their caste marks and follow their own caste**__.
